# Vendored motion runtime

Pinned local copies keep the portfolio’s motion independent of third-party runtime availability.

- `gsap.min.js` — GSAP 3.13.0, from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/gsap.min.js`
- `ScrollTrigger.min.js` — ScrollTrigger 3.13.0, from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js`
- `lenis.min.js` / `lenis.css` — Lenis 1.3.26, from `https://unpkg.com/lenis@1.3.26/dist/`; its MIT terms are included in `LICENSE-LENIS.txt`

Upstream notices are retained where present in the distributed files; Lenis’s separate license is included alongside them. Review upstream terms before changing versions.
